article.body:
OA-MAP targets interpretable knee osteoarthritis progression prediction

OA-MAP is described as an evidence-grounded, multi-agent multimodal framework for predicting knee osteoarthritis progression. The available description identifies its aim but does not specify how its agents or multimodal inputs are implemented.

The paper record and accompanying summary provide no dataset, baseline, metric or experimental result. They therefore do not establish whether OA-MAP improves prediction or interpretability, or how it performs beyond the reported description.
